pipeline: Source receives a user turn in its bot_dm home chat
Source discovers cursor.SendToAgent and invokes it through the authenticated dynamic-tool gateway
One PostgreSQL transaction creates the canonical agent_dm message and both bot_dm projections
The same transaction creates Probe's role=user Message, Run(origin=agent), InboxEvent, and pg-boss wake
The tool returns the asynchronous acknowledgement without waiting for Probe
WakeWorker claims Probe under its per-bot lease and resumes Probe's durable session
Probe replies with cursor.SendToAgent using Source's UUID
A second transaction appends ACK to the canonical pair channel, mirrors both home chats, and queues Source
WakeWorker resumes Source with a fresh role=user [agent] wake
Source stays silent, so the pair transcript ends at exactly two canonical messages
